turns.text: Encrypted data is received, but for some Health Information Providers (HIPs), the following error appears: "HIP did not acknowledge the HIP consent notify. Please try again after some time.

must_contain: The message means at least one HIP has not confirmed the consent notification, and that confirmation is its own step, separate from sending the records
It appears for some HIPs and not others because a consent that covers several HIPs is split into one per HIP, and each HIP is told, and confirms, on its own
Answering the notification with 200 OK is not the acknowledgement; the acknowledgement is POST /api/hiecm/consent/v3/request/hip/on-notify
An HIU whose HIP is another organisation's cannot change it from its own calls: note the HIP and the consentId, try again later, and report it through Support if it persists
notes: NHA QA sample, 30 September 2026: 'Providing generic knowledge and not specific about the topic. Not answering why this error is occurring.' Verdict group: generic rather than situational. The rejected answer explained the message and not why it shows for some HIPs only.
